import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group the data by district and count the number of dogs
district_dog_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Sort the values for better visualization
district_dog_counts = district_dog_counts.sort_values(by='AnzHunde', ascending=False)

# Set the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x='AnzHunde', y='KreisLang', data=district_dog_counts, palette='viridis')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs by District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('District', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot as a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group the data by district and count the number of dogs
district_dog_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Sort the values for better visualization
district_dog_counts = district_dog_counts.sort_values(by='AnzHunde', ascending=False)

# Set the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x='AnzHunde', y='KreisLang', data=district_dog_counts, palette='viridis')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs by District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('District', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot as a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
